claims.statement: The checkout freight endpoint requires an authenticated, rate-limited requester and selects an imported carrier-table band before internal CEP coverage; it calls Uber Direct only when neither internal option applies, returning no option when configuration, address data, coverage, or the provider prevents a quote.

Uber Direct checkout prices are persisted server-side in RLS-protected `cotacoes_frete_externo`, and the order RPC requires an unexpired quote owned by the resolved store and uses its stored centavos fee instead of a client-provided price.
Payment confirmation is idempotent for already-paid/progressed orders and records payment before best-effort notification and dispatch, so dispatch errors do not reverse a confirmed payment.

For a paid order not explicitly selecting Uber Direct, `despachar_corrida_automatica` uses an existing run for the order when present, returns no run for pickup or consolidated freight, and otherwise creates an internal first-accept run priced from the order's total line freight with a five-minute logistics-affiliate exclusivity window.

Post-payment Uber Direct dispatch only proceeds when no internal run exists and the order is eligible; it skips existing runs and consolidated freight, creates an Uber delivery using the order ID as external ID, and persists its provider identifiers and tracking URL in `rotas`.

Consolidated freight reduces each delivery line's charge to 70 percent, marks the order for deferred consolidation rather than immediate dispatch, and an admin batch requires at least two paid consolidated unassigned orders from one store in the same three-digit destination-CEP corridor.

Logistics partner profiles are moderated from Pending to approved status, and approved store logistics affiliates receive a five-minute exclusive window before published runs become available to the general approved-partner pool; acceptance locks and validates the run before assignment.

Internal runs progress through controlled status transitions, while an order-backed run must validate the buyer delivery code before it can be advanced to delivered; a valid code completes all line deliveries, resets attempts, recalculates the payout ledger, and repeated completion is idempotent.

The Uber Direct client uses server-side OAuth client credentials and in-process token caching, creates deliveries with formatted addresses and normalized Brazilian E.164 phone numbers, and is enabled only when all three Uber credential environment variables are present.

The Uber Direct webhook maps provider delivery states and tracking URLs onto `rotas`; with a signing key it verifies `x-uber-signature` via HMAC-SHA256, but when `UBER_DIRECT_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY` is absent signature validation is bypassed.

Route geometry is best effort: Google Routes is called only with a configured key and below the per-process daily limit, and failures return explicit error states while a Google Maps directions link remains available without the integration.
Focused unit tests verify freight-option rounding, internal-over-Uber precedence, Uber fallback/no-coverage behavior, and Brazilian E.164 phone normalization.

A third-party deliverer can confirm a paid order without platform login by providing its sale ID, buyer code, and name; this public path audits success/failure, enforces the five-attempt cap, is idempotent for completed orders, marks all line deliveries complete, and recalculates the payout ledger.

The authenticated run-status RPC permits only the assigned partner or affiliate to move a run through Aceita, Coletada, EmTransito, and Entregue; delivery photo proof is required for standalone runs but not order-backed runs, whose buyer code is validated before the application requests the terminal status transition.

Internal logistics profiles require initial acceptance of the current CMS terms version, and an exclusively assigned affiliate may be required to revise a run's weight, volume, window, and description before accepting it.
Assigned manual routes can be advanced only by their affiliate or logistics partner through Atribuida, EmTransito, and Entregue, without buyer-code validation.
